g.text: W3 closed on the remote first
W5 version target renamed or released early
issue reopened on the host while the task is checked
add task "slug" in the repository's project, label ?stub or ?seed
write draft (version, slug, date, status = draft, empty body)
find content = slug across projects, open then completed (error on more than one
todo add slug --project <mapped> --labels [%deliverable if output non-empty else %actionable]
find version target "<repo>@v0.4.0" in the parent project
ensure milestone "v0.4.0" (state from checked, due from due)
create issue, title = slug, body = dev <slug> --md (checklist from rows), milestone = v0.4.0
ticket description: link line replaced if present, else prepended (D12)
version target description: arrow line -> <repo>#N ... replaced if present, else prepended (D12)
find subtask by content under id, todo done id:<sub>
error row, content drifted, nothing written
error row, task gone, set aborted or clear the reference
result row names the failed leg and the next command
ensure steps find nothing to do
check "nu-fluency@v0.4.0" while member tickets are open
close milestone v0.4.0, open issues stay assigned
dev ignores it: no file exists yet, and ?-labelled tasks are skipped by sync (D7)
seed: dev migrate <slug>, or dev new <slug> --prompt --files <issue.md>
status = draft: the remote leg is skipped (D6); afterwards matching is by reference.todoist.id (D7)
target set but no <repo>@<target> task: error naming dev sync <slug> --create-target, which adds it to the parent project with no section and no labels (D8)
git switch -c <slug>: the track hook resolves the branch to the task
closure is accepted from any surface; reopening from Todoist only (D6)
report only; auto-abort waits for usage to prove the need (D7)
mirrors Todoist: a closed milestone with open issues is allowed on both sides (D8)
